host: MacBook Pro, Apple M3 Pro, 18 GiB unified memory, macOS 14.7.8

protocol.model: Same installed Qwen3.5-0.8B 4-bit MLX weights and full-vocabulary target. CPU llama.cpp drafts under high pressure, MTP/Metal otherwise.
protocol.render: Independent 1280x720 60-Hz Metal renderer, 1450 shader iterations. Service-time P95 describes the simulator. On-device GPU utilization is sampled at 0.5 s where available. No game client or loudspeaker was running.
protocol.timing: Fresh worker per variant per suite, one held-out warmup, interleaved within each case. Fixed sheets time file write and worker IPC to final returned text. Synthetic long includes building the contact sheet. For the original product replay the entry point includes capture selection, scheduling and final parsing. P95 is nearest rank; for eight samples it is the largest value. Three workers (published, initial and candidate) interleaved for the first detailed combat run; the initial worker takes rotating positions. The second combat run reverses the order of each published/candidate pair. Two independent opposite orders also used for the published vs candidate native capture-to-review comparison.
protocol.quality: Complete content requires a valid scene (trim as the product does), nonempty observation and distinct cited frame IDs all within 1–6. For this offline measure, accept a single outer Markdown fence and Frame N labels. Product acceptance is separately measured by the product parser. Scene-only results and invalid/truncated responses remain in all-trial statistics. Each fixed pair compares the same prompt and identical six-frame JPEG bytes. Check exact text and the full output budget. Our fixed diagnostic uses the current product parser for both sides. Native replays run each revision’s own product code.
protocol.long_prompt: 六张连续截图按左上到右下从早到晚排列。请复盘可见变化，只输出 JSON 对象。在 scene 写 fighting、settled 或 unclear；在 observation 用两三句完整中文描述角色或镜头的变化、场景与界面里的可见证据；在 observed_frames 数组写出依据的帧号。看不清的内容请如实说明，不猜测剧情、名称或数值。
protocol.raw: Compact row data below; full local traces and harnesses in profile_output/validation.tar.gz. The capture replay uses local vision, intercepts speech submissions and selects actual frames through the normal scheduler. No physical game client or speaker.
